title: Chapter 257
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

The shockwave from the collision hit them head-on. When the dust settled, a circular sandpit was formed where the two of them were standing. Bennett's fivefold critical hit was earth-shattering, but the two of them shook at the same time. Neither of them had the upper hand!

The two of them exchanged punches, and their movements were dazzling. It was like a black and purple python tearing at a white dragon. Wherever they passed, be it friend or foe, they all retreated in fear.

"What the f * ck, so reckless." Han Xiao clenched his teeth. Both of them were Pugilists, and they had all kinds of talents and skills. They were both from different Pugilist schools. Bennett had a sense of 'just right', showing off his combat experience to the fullest.

The leader's style, on the other hand, was violent, wild, and cruel, just like the color of his flames.

The combat strength of these two beasts was obviously half a level higher than other high-level Supers. They had multiple templates and rare talents, and they were both boss-level Supers.

"As expected of the main character of the planet." Han Technician's eyes suddenly sparkled. "Bennett used Flaming Will to deal fivefold damage. Since the leader was able to block it, he definitely has a similar powerful skill."

Thinking about the reward of [Traitor's Counterattack], Han Xiaoxin felt his head heat up. He knew that many hidden missions could give powerful skills and talents, but this mission was the simplest and most brutal. As long as he won, he would have a chance to eat fatty meat. It was very cost-effective.

Han Xiao cooperated with his teammates to deal with the other enemies while calculating the combat strength of the leader. The result was not optimistic. First of all, he had been through many battles, and his current condition was average. He only had Viper left. As a Mechanic, not having enough equipment meant not being in good condition.

"If it's a one on one battle, with my current equipment, even if I perform a little better, both of us will be heavily injured at most. Plus, Bennett won't let me do that … If I attack the leader with Bennett, I won't be able to deal more damage than Bennett. Bennett also has Flaming Will, and it's even better than mine …" Han Xiao was helpless.

He thought for a moment. The best thing to do now was to maintain the current situation and let Bennett wrestle with the leader alone. The two of them were evenly matched. Although they were fighting fiercely, their HP dropped very slowly. Both of them were able to parry each other's attacks, so the outcome of the battle would not be decided in a short time. Moreover, no matter friend or foe, no one had any intention of interfering in the fierce battle between Bennett and the leader.

"As expected of a Legend. Our leader is stronger than any of us. Only Bennett can hold him back. We can't interfere in the battle there," Tang Tang said through the communicator as he waved a gust of wind, creating a sandstorm to control the situation.

Bennett was the strongest link, and everyone tacitly agreed on this point. Even if they were arrogant, they were very convinced by the famous Bennett.

"The army is fighting a war of attrition with us. Right now, we are in a stalemate. Our strongest forces are restraining each other. Whoever wins will break the balance and change the entire situation."

Falchord, who was releasing the energy shield, said. Everyone else agreed with this point of view.

Han Xiao heard this, and his mind turned. He saw a turning point in completing the mission. He thought to himself, Since the situation is in a stalemate, it's equivalent to squeezing out some time for me. This is the key to completing [The Traitor's Counterattack]. The turning point is the advancement mission [The Ultimate Trial]! As long as I advance, I will be able to defeat the leader!

With so many helpers around him and so many enemies, it was the best opportunity to gain trial points! Furthermore, Han Xiao had found the correct method. After the battle ended, he would gain extra trial points based on the difference in numbers between the two sides. Therefore, according to the previous statistics, he could roughly calculate how many extra trial points he had gained from killing enemies. Then, after leaving the battlefield once, he would be able to reach 2,000 points in the post-battle calculation!

Defeating the leader meant successfully breaking out of the encirclement, which did not conflict with this mission. Han Xiao knew how to grasp the opportunity. If he missed this opportunity, there would not be another one!

The two sides were in a fierce battle. Han Xiao's high-end forces were crushing the Germinal Organization. From time to time, there were executive officers who were injured and vomiting blood. Han Xiao was coordinating the overall situation through the combat information on the interface. He was sneakily taking advantage of the situation and even snatching kills from his teammates. His efficiency in harvesting trial points was unprecedented.

If players were there, they would be able to tell at a glance that he was snatching kills. However, these teammates were not players. Seeing that Han Xiao was only sneaking around and shooting, they thought that Han Xiao was tired and was not in his best condition.

They thought that Han Xiao would be a powerful helper, but now it seemed that he would not be of any use. This mission had become a babysitter. Diana, whose temper was as hot as a superpower, directly assigned the mission. "Black Phantom, you are of no use here. Don't worry about the supers. You go and deal with the small fries."

Since Black Phantom was not in his best condition, the best plan was to let him deal with the small fries. Diana's decision was not a problem in the eyes of the others, but Han Xiao just said a few perfunctory words and continued to do his own thing, not listening to their orders.

Everyone's expression changed. Han Xiao was not willing to listen to orders. Could it be that he thought that he was a protected target and watched them work for him?

They were all teammates and should be fighting side by side. Furthermore, they were here to provide support, but he did this …

Everyone looked unhappy. Diana wanted to scold him, but she was attacked. She quickly blocked the attack and did not say anything. "Humph, he is a traitor of the Germinal Organization. He hides here and there to poach people, instigating a war behind the scenes. He is indeed a despicable person."
